_comment: Shared REAPER <-> Voicemeeter routing presets. Strip indexes are Remote API indexes (0-4 hardware, 5 Voicemeeter Input, 6 AUX, 7 VAIO3). Channels are 1-based on both sides.

presets.title: Hear the REAPER mix through Voicemeeter (REAPER on any ASIO device)
presets.reaper: Audio Bridge on the master track, mode Send REAPER audio, Send to: Voicemeeter VAIO3 Input. Master channels 1-2 go to the plugin.

presets.title: Hear the REAPER mix on the AUX strip (keeps VAIO3 for Windows)
presets.reaper: Audio Bridge on the master track, mode Send REAPER audio, Send to: Voicemeeter AUX Input. Master channels 1-2.

presets.title: Hear the REAPER mix on its own strip, Stereo Input 4 (VAIO extension)
presets.reaper: Audio Bridge on the master track, mode Send REAPER audio, Send to: Voicemeeter In 4. Master channels 1-2.
presets.voicemeeter: Stereo Input 4 channels 1-2 (L/R), VAIO switch on, routed to A1. Leaves AUX and VAIO3 free for Windows apps.

presets.title: Record whatever apps play to AUX (e.g. Discord) on a REAPER track
presets.reaper: Audio Bridge on the record track, mode Capture system audio, Capture from: Voicemeeter AUX Input (whole device). Track channels 1-2.
presets.voicemeeter: Captures the AUX endpoint before the mixer, so strip 7 routing doesn't matter. Don't also send REAPER audio to AUX.

presets.title: REAPER on WASAPI: record the mic bus B1, return the mix into AUX
presets.reaper: Preferences > Audio > Device: WASAPI, input Voicemeeter Out B1 (channels 1-2), output Voicemeeter AUX Input (channels 1-2). This is the saved WASAPI setup in REAPER.ini.
presets.voicemeeter: Strip 7 (AUX) routed to A1 and never to B1, or the return re-enters REAPER's input.

presets.title: Process Stereo Input 1 (mic) in REAPER as a Voicemeeter insert
presets.reaper: Preferences > Audio > Device: ASIO, Voicemeeter Potato Insert Virtual ASIO. Record/monitor a track on inputs 1-2, output it to outputs 1-2.
presets.voicemeeter: Patch insert channels 1-2 on. While on, Stereo Input 1 only passes audio through REAPER.

presets.title: Process the Voicemeeter Input strip (strip 6) in REAPER as an insert
presets.reaper: Preferences > Audio > Device: ASIO, Voicemeeter Potato Insert Virtual ASIO. Inputs/outputs 11-12 carry strip 6 L/R (11-18 for all 8 channels).
presets.voicemeeter: Patch insert channels 11-18 on. While on, strip 6 only passes audio through REAPER.
